english.title: Fail to ensure unserviceable recording apparatus is rendered serviceable as soon as reasonably practicable
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person in charge of air traffic service equipment, failed to ensure that apparatus, namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..), which was provided in compliance with article 206(2) or (3) of the Air Navigation Order 2016 and became unserviceable was rendered serviceable again as soon as reasonably practicable
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 206(9) and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
